say:1:1322534001:1.text: The guards have been working non-stop lately, so I was thinking of treating them to something special.
say:1:1322534001:1.source_cn: 侍卫们已经连续工作许久了，我总想着弄点好吃的慰劳一下大家。
say:1:1322534001:1.male: The guards have been working non-stop lately, so I was thinking of treating them to something special.
say:1:1322534001:1.female: The guards have been working non-stop lately, so I was thinking of treating them to something special.

say:2:1322534002:1.text: I remember when they'd go fishing on their days off. The fish they caught always tasted better than what you buy at the market... it's been a while since we had a good fried fish.
say:2:1322534002:1.source_cn: 我记得以前侍卫们在假日里会一起约着钓鱼，钓上来的鱼比市...
say:2:1322534002:1.male: I remember when they'd go fishing on their days off. The fish they caught always tasted better than what you buy at the market... it's been a while since we had a good fried fish.
say:2:1322534002:1.female: I remember when they'd go fishing on their days off. The fish they caught always tasted better than what you buy at the market... it's been a while since we had a good fried fish.

say:3:1322534003:1.text: Magister, if you have a moment, could you catch a few fish for the guards? Consider it a personal request... I've been missing those days.
say:3:1322534003:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，如果您有空的话，能为侍卫们钓几条鱼吗？就算...
say:3:1322534003:1.male: Magister, if you have a moment, could you catch a few fish for the guards? Consider it a personal request... I've been missing those days.
say:3:1322534003:1.female: Magister, if you have a moment, could you catch a few fish for the guards? Consider it a personal request... I've been missing those days.
